description: Curated held-out clinical DDI pairs covering Major, Moderate, Minor, and None classes with canonical RDKit SMILES.

pairs.mechanism: Additive antiplatelet and vitamin K antagonist anticoagulation.
pairs.management: Avoid concurrent use unless explicitly supervised with frequent INR monitoring.

pairs.mechanism: NSAID-induced GI mucosal injury plus antiplatelet effect with anticoagulation.
pairs.management: Avoid concomitant NSAIDs; consider acetaminophen with INR monitoring.

pairs.mechanism: Additive GI bleeding risk and CYP2C9 competition.
pairs.management: Avoid concurrent systemic diclofenac with warfarin.

pairs.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inhibition dramatically increases simvastatin exposure and rhabdomyolysis risk.
pairs.management: Contraindicated; suspend simvastatin during clarithromycin therapy.

pairs.mechanism: Potent CYP2C9 inhibition increases S-warfarin levels and INR.
pairs.management: Reduce warfarin dose proactively and monitor INR closely.

pairs.mechanism: CYP2C19 inhibition impairs bioactivation of clopidogrel prodrug.
pairs.management: Switch omeprazole to pantoprazole.

pairs.mechanism: P-glycoprotein inhibition doubles serum digoxin concentrations.
pairs.management: Halve digoxin dose and monitor serum levels and ECG.

pairs.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inhibition elevates statin toxicity risk.
pairs.management: Avoid concurrent therapy.

pairs.mechanism: Reduced renal tubular clearance of methotrexate causing severe myelosuppression.
pairs.management: Avoid NSAIDs with high-dose methotrexate; monitor CBC and renal function.

pairs.mechanism: Additive potassium retention causing severe hyperkalemia.
pairs.management: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely.

pairs.mechanism: Alteration of vitamin K producing gut flora can elevate INR.
pairs.management: Monitor INR during and shortly after antibiotic course.

pairs.mechanism: Prostaglandin inhibition blunts antihypertensive effect and reduces renal perfusion.
pairs.management: Monitor blood pressure and serum creatinine.

pairs.mechanism: Moderate CYP3A4 inhibition increases atorvastatin exposure.
pairs.management: Use lowest effective statin dose and monitor for myalgia.

pairs.mechanism: Additive glucose-lowering effect increases hypoglycemia risk.
pairs.management: Monitor blood glucose regularly.

pairs.mechanism: Minor renal prostaglandin overlap at high prolonged dosing.
pairs.management: Safe for short-term supervised alternating therapy within daily limits.

pairs.mechanism: Additive blood-pressure reduction (frequently prescribed therapeutically).
pairs.management: Monitor for symptomatic hypotension on initiation.

pairs.mechanism: Minimal CYP2C19 inhibition; rare isolated INR fluctuations reported.
pairs.management: Routine INR monitoring is typically sufficient.

pairs.management: No special precautions required.
